caveats: Two weekly readings. Not a baseline — a range with two points in it.

3D is the default basis: it is what Walmart's AEO channel reports on and what every other channel in the scorecard is measured against. Verified via AOV ($101), CR (8.3%) and the stated SEO shares. Same-session is carried as a floor.
Only W16's 3D pair is directly attested; W17's is derived from the email's stated WoW deltas applied to the W16 3D level.
Both weeks fall inside a window Walmart flagged volatile pending OpenAI feed indexation, completed 6/15/2026.
No AI seasonal history exists, so an AI trajectory carries NO seasonality. Borrowing retail seasonality would be an assumption dressed as data.
W16 was a record week (+9% WoW); W17 fell -19%. Annualising either alone is a run-rate on one point.

Walmart's SEO visit count (30M/wk) is ~2x our Google+Bing click archive. Different measurement systems; do not reconcile them. Use the SHARE ratios, which are internally consistent, for anything comparative.
